notes.title: [Game Content News] We will upgrade and change the game characters!
notes.content:
Hello and good day!

Thank you for keeping up with us here.
Because of you guys supporting us we can still survive here.
With this I want to give some updates related to how the games will be from next year!

Firstly we will change most of the character designs, name, and placements.
But there will be no change for the characters nature and content progression,
Same with gameplay, we won't have drastic change with the gameplay prepared and how the world is depicted.
We hope for this we can maintain your excitement about what we promise will deliver.

Secondly for the reason itself...
This is hard to say but, the original artist and lead dev is goes MIA and I guess won't be back to this project.
So finally just this month, we found a replacement that I guarantee you guys will love it.

We will kickstart the development soon again so I hope you will keep eyes on how this project will develop.

Best regards,
